description: This file defines a mock class for the MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService used in unit testing. It includes mock methods for client connection management and MIME type support queries, and references external protobuf and IPC interfaces.

classes.name: MediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleServiceMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of IMediaPipelineCapabilitiesModuleService for testing purposes, providing mocked methods for client connection and MIME type support.

methods.name: clientConnected
methods.description: Mocks the client connection event, taking a shared pointer to an IClient object.

methods.name: clientDisconnected
methods.description: Mocks the client disconnection event, taking a shared pointer to an IClient object.

methods.name: getSupportedMimeTypes
methods.description: Mocks the retrieval of supported MIME types, with protobuf controller, request, response, and callback parameters.

methods.name: isMimeTypeSupported
methods.description: Mocks the check if a MIME type is supported, with protobuf controller, request, response, and callback parameters.
